intro: Twelve matches told as stories, with the scorecard facts behind them. Where the ball-by-ball record is in the archive, the 'relive' panel plays the key overs.

matches.title: 148 against Pakistan
matches.subtitle: The hair, the sixes, the arrival
story: Four ODIs into his career he had 22 runs and a run-out on debut. Sourav Ganguly, who had asked for him, sent him in at No.3 in the second ODI of a home series against Pakistan with India 26/1.

He hit 148 off 123 balls with 15 fours and 4 sixes, the highest score by an Indian wicketkeeper at the time, launching Mohammad Sami and Abdul Razzaq straight and over midwicket in a way Indian crowds had not seen from a keeper. India made 356 and won by 58.
The innings made the long hair and the cross-bat swing a national fashion. Pervez Musharraf would tell him, a year later in Lahore, not to cut it.

quote.text: I was told to go in at three and just play my game.

matches.title: 183 not out against Sri Lanka
matches.subtitle: The record that still stands
story: Sri Lanka made 298/4, Sangakkara 138. India lost Tendulkar in the first over. Dhoni came in at No.3 again.

183 not out off 145 balls, 15 fours and 10 sixes, the highest score in an ODI chase at the time and still the highest by a wicketkeeper twenty years later. India won with 23 balls to spare. He passed Adam Gilchrist's 172 along the way.
It was the innings that took him to No.1 in the ICC ODI batting rankings within six months, the first Indian to get there.

matches.title: World T20 final v Pakistan
matches.subtitle: The Joginder over
story: India's senior players had opted out; the 26-year-old captain had a squad with an average age of 24 and a format the BCCI had barely acknowledged. They beat Pakistan in a bowl-out, lost to New Zealand, then beat England (Yuvraj's six sixes), South Africa and Australia (Yuvraj 70 off 30) to reach a final against Pakistan.

Gambhir's 75 took India to 157/5. Pakistan slid to 77/6 before Misbah-ul-Haq hit Harbhajan for three sixes in an over. 13 needed off the last over, one wicket left, and Dhoni gave the ball to Joginder Sharma, who had played four ODIs.

Wide. Dot. Six over long-off. Then the scoop to short fine leg, where Sreesanth, who had been moved there, held it. India were the first world champions of Twenty20 and the captaincy of the next decade was decided.
matches.stat: India 157/5 · Pakistan 152 (19.3 ov) · Irfan Pathan 3/16, player of the match

quote.text: I had faith in Joginder. He has done it for us before.

matches.source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard, ICC World Twenty20 final

matches.title: CB Series second final v Australia
matches.subtitle: Young legs in Australia
story: Weeks after the Sydney Test and the Harbhajan–Symonds hearing, Dhoni had left Ganguly and Dravid out of the one-day squad and told the press he wanted fielders. The side he took into the finals had Rohit Sharma, Robin Uthappa, Praveen Kumar and Piyush Chawla.

Tendulkar made 117 not out in the first final at Sydney and 91 in the second at Brisbane. Australia needed 259; Praveen Kumar took 4/46 and Australia finished 249. India had won a tri-series in Australia for the first time and beaten the world champions in a final.
It was the first time his selection instinct was tested in public. It would be the template: pick the young player who can field, back him through the first failure.

matches.title: World Cup final v Sri Lanka
matches.subtitle: The six
story: Sri Lanka 274/6, Jayawardene 103 not out. Sehwag lbw second ball, Tendulkar caught behind for 18. Gambhir and Kohli rebuilt to 114 before Kohli was caught and bowled by Dilshan.

Dhoni had made 150 runs in seven innings in the tournament. He walked in ahead of Yuvraj Singh, the player of the tournament. He and Gambhir added 109. Gambhir fell for 97. Dhoni, 91 not out off 79 balls, hit Kulasekara over long-on with 10 balls to spare. He had been unflappable all night; the bat twirl afterwards was the first sign of emotion.

India had not won the World Cup since 1983. Tendulkar was carried round the ground; Dhoni, who had been asked all tournament whether he was in form, was player of the match. Yuvraj said he had sent himself in because it was the right thing to do, and that was all.

quote.text: Dhoni finishes off in style. A magnificent strike into the crowd. India lift the World Cup after 28 years.

matches.source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard, ICC Cricket World Cup final

matches.title: 113 not out v Pakistan
matches.subtitle: A century with nine wickets gone
story: India were 29/5 against Junaid Khan and Mohammad Irfan in the first ODI of a rare bilateral series. Dhoni batted through to 113 not out off 125 balls, the last 49 with Nos 9, 10 and 11, to reach 227/6.

Pakistan chased it with 11 balls to spare, Nasir Jamshed 101 not out. The innings is remembered because it was a losing one: he was never a captain who scored easy hundreds, and this was the closest to a solo rescue he managed in a home defeat.

matches.title: 224 v Australia
matches.subtitle: A Test double with the series at stake
story: Australia made 380 and India were 12/2, then 196/4 when Dhoni came in. With Kohli (107) and then Bhuvneshwar Kumar (38) he put on 128 and 140. He hit 224 off 265 balls, 24 fours and 6 sixes, with Nathan Lyon and Peter Siddle both hit into the stands at the pavilion end.

It was the highest Test score by an Indian captain at the time, the first Test double-hundred by an Indian wicketkeeper, and it came the week after England had beaten India 2–1 at home and the Test captaincy was being openly questioned.
India won by eight wickets and swept the series 4–0, Australia's first whitewash in a four-Test series since 1970.

matches.title: Champions Trophy final v England
matches.subtitle: The treble, in the rain
story: Rain cut the final to 20 overs a side and still nearly washed it out. India, who had been unbeaten and had not needed to bat deep, made 129/7; Kohli 43, Jadeja 33 not out off 25.

England were 46/4 before Morgan and Bopara took them to 110/4 after 17 overs. Ishant Sharma, who had gone for 27 in three, bowled the 18th: two wides, then Morgan to midwicket and Bopara to short fine leg. Jadeja ran out Jos Buttler, Ashwin bowled the last over with 15 needed, and England finished 124/8.
The ICC had said this would be the last Champions Trophy. Dhoni now had the World T20, the World Cup and the Champions Trophy, a set no captain has completed before or since.
matches.stat: India 129/7 (20 ov) · England 124/8 · Jadeja 2/24 and 33*, player of the match

quote.text: The lesser-experienced bowlers were the ones I thought could do it; the pressure was on the batters.
quote.source: Dhoni, post-match presentation, 23 June 2013 (paraphrased from the ICC broadcast)

matches.source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard, ICC Champions Trophy final

matches.title: Tri-series final v Sri Lanka
matches.subtitle: 15 off the last over
story: Chasing 202 India were 182/9 with Dhoni, back from a hamstring injury he had been nursing through the series, batting with Ishant Sharma. Eranga's last over: 15 needed.

Six over long-on, four through extra cover, six over midwicket. 45 not out off 52, having scored 30 of them in the last four overs. It is the innings most often shown to explain what 'taking it deep' meant.

matches.title: The last Test, Melbourne
matches.subtitle: Retired at the MCG
story: India had lost at Adelaide (under Kohli, with Dhoni injured) and Brisbane. At Melbourne they held on for a draw, Dhoni 11 not out at the end with Ashwin, after Australia set 384.

An hour after the close the BCCI released a statement: he was retiring from Tests with immediate effect, citing the strain of playing all three formats. There was no farewell press conference. Kohli captained at Sydney.
matches.stat: 90th and last Test · 4,876 runs · 256 catches, 38 stumpings · 27 wins as captain

quote.text: One of the greatest Test captains India has had.

matches.title: World T20 v Bangladesh
matches.subtitle: Three balls, two runs, one glove
story: India made 146/7 and Bangladesh needed 11 off the last over, then 2 off 3 with Mushfiqur Rahim and Mahmudullah set. Both tried to finish it with a boundary and were caught in the deep.

Last ball, 2 needed, the tail-ender Shuvagata Hom on strike. Dhoni had taken his right glove off before Hardik Pandya ran in. The ball beat the bat; Dhoni collected it on the move and ran Mustafizur Rahman out at the bowler's end by a stride. India stayed in the tournament.
matches.source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard, ICC World T20 2016, Super 10

matches.title: World Cup semi-final v New Zealand
matches.subtitle: The last innings
story: Rain carried the semi-final into a second day. New Zealand's 239/8 looked light until India were 5/3 after Rohit, Kohli and Rahul were out for one each, then 24/4, then 92/6.

Dhoni and Jadeja added 116 for the seventh wicket. Jadeja made 77 off 59 and fell with 32 needed off 13. Dhoni hit Lockie Ferguson for six to bring it to 25 off 10 and went for a second next ball; Martin Guptill's direct hit from backward point found him short by inches.
He walked off at 50 off 72. He did not play for India again and said nothing in public for thirteen months.
matches.source: ESPNcricinfo scorecard, ICC Cricket World Cup 2019 semi-final

matches.title: IPL final v Gujarat Titans
matches.subtitle: The fifth, on one knee
story: Rain pushed the final to the reserve day. Gujarat made 214/4; CSK's chase was cut to 171 off 15 overs. Dhoni was out first ball to Mohit Sharma. With 13 needed off the last over, Mohit took it to 10 off 2; Jadeja hit a six and a four.

Dhoni had played the season with a knee that needed surgery days later, had batted almost nowhere, and had kept wicket every game. It was his tenth final as captain and his fifth win, level with Rohit Sharma. The crowd at every away ground that season had been yellow.
